findings.evidence: Abstract: Co-teaching relies on the memorization effect (networks fit clean labels first) and selects possibly clean samples per mini-batch during training.

findings.quote: Many selection methods need a clean validation set, or the training dynamics of deep networks, as in small-loss selection and co-teaching \citep{han2018coteaching,song2023learning}.

findings.quote: Filtering with cross-validated predictions is older \citep{brodley1999identifying}

findings.quote: Surveys group methods for deep networks \citep{song2023learning}

findings.quote: Loss correction estimates a matrix of class-corruption probabilities and adjusts the loss \citep{patrini2017making}.

findings.quote: Noise-tolerant losses are chosen so that the minimizer survives label noise \citep{ghosh2017robust}.
findings.evidence: Abstract: sufficient conditions on a loss so that risk minimization is inherently tolerant to label noise; mean absolute error meets them.

findings.quote: Noise models can also sit inside logistic regression \citep{bootkrajang2014learning,lee2021individual}.

findings.quote: Noise models can also sit inside logistic regression \citep{bootkrajang2014learning,lee2021individual}.
findings.evidence: Abstract: label noise logistic regression with a flexible transition model (binary case).

findings.quote: Co-teaching has two networks exchange their small-loss samples \citep{han2018coteaching}.
findings.evidence: Abstract: each network selects data of possibly clean labels in a mini-batch and passes them to its peer, which trains on them.

findings.quote: Co-teaching+ selects among the samples on which the two networks disagree \citep{yu2019how}.
findings.evidence: Abstract: keeps prediction-disagreement data only, then each network selects small-loss data among them.

findings.quote: Area Under the Margin ranks samples by their training dynamics \citep{pleiss2020identifying}.
findings.evidence: Abstract: the AUM statistic exploits differences in the training dynamics of clean and mislabeled samples.

findings.quote: Confident learning prunes instances using out-of-sample predicted probabilities, per-class thresholds and an estimate of the number of label errors \citep{northcutt2021confident}.
findings.evidence: Abstract: pruning noisy data, counting with probabilistic thresholds to estimate noise; the card describes per-class thresholds.
